GRADE 8 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Time: 64 minutes

INSTRUCTIONS
1. Answer all questions.
2. Use neat handwriting.
2. For multiple choice, write the correct letter only.
3. For short answers, write clearly in the spaces provided.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A: Multiple Choice

1. About Modes of preservation of the Qur’an at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. describe the modes of preservation of the Qur’an during the time of the Prophet (S.A.W.), the Rightly Guided Caliphs and presently for posterity,
   B. Learners should ignore Modes of preservation of the Qur’an completely.
   C. Modes of preservation of the Qur’an is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Modes of preservation of the Qur’an.

2. About Modes of preservation of the Qur’an at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. recite chapters/verses of the Qur’an as a means of preserving it,
   B. Learners should ignore Modes of preservation of the Qur’an completely.
   C. Modes of preservation of the Qur’an is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Modes of preservation of the Qur’an.

3. About Modes of preservation of the Qur’an when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. assess the importance of preserving the Qur’an to safeguard its authenticity,
   B. Learners should ignore Modes of preservation of the Qur’an completely.
   C. Modes of preservation of the Qur’an is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Modes of preservation of the Qur’an.

5. About Divisions of the Qur’an Madinan Surah at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. explain the divisions of the Qur’an for easy referencing,
   B. Learners should ignore Divisions of the Qur’an Madinan Surah completely.
   C. Divisions of the Qur’an Madinan Surah is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Divisions of the Qur’an Madinan Surah.

6. About Divisions of the Qur’an Madinan Surah at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. identify the divisions of the Qur’an to facilitate the reading of the Qur’an,
   B. Learners should ignore Divisions of the Qur’an Madinan Surah completely.
   C. Divisions of the Qur’an Madinan Surah is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Divisions of the Qur’an Madinan Surah.

7. About Divisions of the Qur’an Madinan Surah when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. describe the characteristics of Makkan and Madinan Surahs to ease learning,
   B. Learners should ignore Divisions of the Qur’an Madinan Surah completely.
   C. Divisions of the Qur’an Madinan Surah is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Divisions of the Qur’an Madinan Surah.

9. About Selected verses at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. read the selected verses correctly for spiritual nourishment,
   B. Learners should ignore Selected verses completely.
   C. Selected verses is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Selected verses.

10. About Selected verses at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. explain the meaning of the selected verses to ease application,
   B. Learners should ignore Selected verses completely.
   C. Selected verses is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Selected verses.

11. About Selected verses when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. explain the teachings of the selected verses for character building,
   B. Learners should ignore Selected verses completely.
   C. Selected verses is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Selected verses.

13. About Ulum al- Hadith at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. describe the factors that led to the development of Hadith during the time of the Prophet (S.A.W.) and the Rightly Guided Caliphs,
   B. Learners should ignore Ulum al- Hadith completely.
   C. Ulum al- Hadith is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Ulum al- Hadith.

14. About Ulum al- Hadith at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. explain the methods used by the Prophet (S.A.W.) to teach Hadith,
   B. Learners should ignore Ulum al- Hadith completely.
   C. Ulum al- Hadith is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Ulum al- Hadith.

15. About Ulum al- Hadith when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. apply the methods used by the Prophet (S.A.W.) to teach Hadith,
   B. Learners should ignore Ulum al- Hadith completely.
   C. Ulum al- Hadith is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Ulum al- Hadith.

17. About Belief in revealed scriptures at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. identify the revealed scriptures to strengthen their Iman,
   B. Learners should ignore Belief in revealed scriptures completely.
   C. Belief in revealed scriptures is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Belief in revealed scriptures.

18. About Belief in revealed scriptures at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. assess the importance of believing in the revealed scriptures as a pillar of Iman,
   B. Learners should ignore Belief in revealed scriptures completely.
   C. Belief in revealed scriptures is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Belief in revealed scriptures.

19. About Belief in revealed scriptures when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. explain the reasons for the revelation of the revealed scriptures as a guide for mankind,
   B. Learners should ignore Belief in revealed scriptures completely.
   C. Belief in revealed scriptures is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Belief in revealed scriptures.

21. About Ulul-Azm Prophets at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. describe the qualities of Ulul-Azm Prophets for emulation,
   B. Learners should ignore Ulul-Azm Prophets completely.
   C. Ulul-Azm Prophets is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Ulul-Azm Prophets.

22. About Ulul-Azm Prophets at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. narrate the stories of Nabii Musa (A.S.) and Issa (A.S.) for spiritual nourishment,
   B. Learners should ignore Ulul-Azm Prophets completely.
   C. Ulul-Azm Prophets is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Ulul-Azm Prophets.

23. About Ulul-Azm Prophets when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. apply the teachings from the stories of Nabii Musa (A.S.) and Issa (A.S.) for character building,
   B. Learners should ignore Ulul-Azm Prophets completely.
   C. Ulul-Azm Prophets is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Ulul-Azm Prophets.

25. About Prayers on special occasions Istisqaa Istikhara at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. describe how swalatul Istisqaa and swalatul Istikhara are performed to earn Allah (S.W.T.)’s blessings,
   B. Learners should ignore Prayers on special occasions Istisqaa Istikhara completely.
   C. Prayers on special occasions Istisqaa Istikhara is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Prayers on special occasions Istisqaa Istikhara.

26. About Prayers on special occasions Istisqaa Istikhara at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. assess the significance of performing swalatul Istisqaa and swalatul Istikhara to seek Allah (S.W.T.)’s bounties,
   B. Learners should ignore Prayers on special occasions Istisqaa Istikhara completely.
   C. Prayers on special occasions Istisqaa Istikhara is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Prayers on special occasions Istisqaa Istikhara.

27. About Prayers on special occasions Istisqaa Istikhara when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. perform swalatul Istisqaa and swalatul Istikhara in the correct way,
   B. Learners should ignore Prayers on special occasions Istisqaa Istikhara completely.
   C. Prayers on special occasions Istisqaa Istikhara is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Prayers on special occasions Istisqaa Istikhara.

29. About Hajj and Umrah 07 5 Akhlaq 5.1 Commanding good and forbidding evil 06 5.2 Virtue at home with your family, which statement is correct?
   A. Explain the meaning of Hajj and Umrah 07 5 Akhlaq 5.1 Commanding good and forbidding evil 06 5.2 Virtue using a Kenyan example.
   B. Learners should ignore Hajj and Umrah 07 5 Akhlaq 5.1 Commanding good and forbidding evil 06 5.2 Virtue completely.
   C. Hajj and Umrah 07 5 Akhlaq 5.1 Commanding good and forbidding evil 06 5.2 Virtue is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Hajj and Umrah 07 5 Akhlaq 5.1 Commanding good and forbidding evil 06 5.2 Virtue.

30. About Hajj and Umrah 07 5 Akhlaq 5.1 Commanding good and forbidding evil 06 5.2 Virtue at your place of worship, which statement is correct?
   A. Practise Hajj and Umrah 07 5 Akhlaq 5.1 Commanding good and forbidding evil 06 5.2 Virtue at school and at home.
   B. Learners should ignore Hajj and Umrah 07 5 Akhlaq 5.1 Commanding good and forbidding evil 06 5.2 Virtue completely.
   C. Hajj and Umrah 07 5 Akhlaq 5.1 Commanding good and forbidding evil 06 5.2 Virtue is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Hajj and Umrah 07 5 Akhlaq 5.1 Commanding good and forbidding evil 06 5.2 Virtue.

31. About Hajj and Umrah 07 5 Akhlaq 5.1 Commanding good and forbidding evil 06 5.2 Virtue when helping a neighbour, which statement is correct?
   A. Hajj and Umrah 07 5 Akhlaq 5.1 Commanding good and forbidding evil 06 5.2 Virtue helps learners in daily life in Kenya.
   B. Learners should ignore Hajj and Umrah 07 5 Akhlaq 5.1 Commanding good and forbidding evil 06 5.2 Virtue completely.
   C. Hajj and Umrah 07 5 Akhlaq 5.1 Commanding good and forbidding evil 06 5.2 Virtue is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Hajj and Umrah 07 5 Akhlaq 5.1 Commanding good and forbidding evil 06 5.2 Virtue.

SECTION B: Short Answers

4. Give two examples of how you can use Modes of preservation of the Qur’an at home with your family.

8. Give two examples of how you can use Divisions of the Qur’an Madinan Surah at home with your family.

12. Give two examples of how you can use Selected verses at home with your family.

16. Give two examples of how you can use Ulum al- Hadith at home with your family.

20. Give two examples of how you can use Belief in revealed scriptures at home with your family.

24. Give two examples of how you can use Ulul-Azm Prophets at home with your family.

28. Give two examples of how you can use Prayers on special occasions Istisqaa Istikhara at home with your family.

32. Give two examples of how you can use Hajj and Umrah 07 5 Akhlaq 5.1 Commanding good and forbidding evil 06 5.2 Virtue at home with your family.
